slides.title: Identity Crisis Control Tower
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · Missing validator does not stop review-file publication
slides.fix: Require ok is True before a validated sign-off.
slides.notes: A synthetic sign-off passed to save with a nonexistent validator wrote readiness.signed.json. The returned message explicitly said the findings were not checked. This is a fail-open save policy, not a hidden claim that validation ran.

slides.title: 2 · Browser starts permissive for unavailable checks
slides.fix: Default to strict; distinguish incomplete runs from ordinary readiness.
slides.notes: Fresh browser option was on. All 14 registrations loaded and all eight built-in cards had their checks; this risk is conditional on a required check being unavailable. Earlier API synthetic unknown-check probe remains valid.

slides.title: 3 · Robustness failures disappear into empty objects
slides.fix: Record not-run, error type and affected claim as explicit evidence states.
slides.notes: Injected a ValueError into the robustness calculation only. assess returned a document with no explicit occurrence of the failure or reason. This is controlled fault injection, not evidence that the ordinary calculation always crashes.

slides.title: 4 · Reported group size includes unmeasured values
slides.fix: Preserve reference-compatible eligible counts but add measured counts and missing counts for each group beside the estimates.
slides.notes: With 20 eligible positive samples and one missing measurement, run_a1 reported n_positive=20, actual measured count=19, and a mean of 2.001. This matches the documented reference convention; add the measured denominator rather than silently changing reference-compatible fields.

slides.title: 5 · Bootstrap independence needs a stated unit
slides.fix: State the sampling unit and verify one independent patient per unit, or use patient-cluster resampling when the question requires it.
slides.notes: No repeated-patient issue was found in the verified public A1 selection. A separate synthetic specimen-duplication probe narrows the sample bootstrap interval without adding patients. Document the independence assumption for future data; do not count this as an observed event-cohort defect.

slides.title: 6 · Same-path input changes can leave cached results stale
slides.fix: Bind analysis caches to input content or immutable release versions.
slides.notes: Actual browser: removed one invented eligible sample, Show results stayed114, changing a cache argument refreshed113. Inputs restored.

slides.title: 7 · A receipt can retain an older question context
slides.fix: Invalidate current approval using evidence and policy digests.
slides.notes: Deterministic AppTest with approved review retained old receipt while rendering new context. Separate browser navigation/Request more evidence path withdrew it. Do not generalize beyond these paths.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: 96 submitted tests passed; three practice-dependent tests skipped. Nine of eleven browser checks met proposed safeguards. Separate AppTest evidence-context probe retained a stale approved receipt; another browser route withdrew it. See exact scopes.
